correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the stated 20-vertex cubic graph with 30 edges; vertex subsets give exactly 6,113 nonempty independent faces, f-vector (20,160,660,1510,1923,1310,450,75,5). Independently reconstructed 3,054 disjoint discrete-Morse pairs, full 29,610 Hasse cover acyclicity, and critical cells one 0-cell, three 4-cells, one 5-cell. Recomputed the signed integral Morse 5→4 differential (1,0,-1), a primitive vector, hence the resulting CW attachment kills one of three 4-sphere generators and Ind(F5)≃S4∨S4 integrally, not just homology. Verified unique graph 5-cycle on the five b-vertices; dihedral maps r,s preserve all 30 edges and give 20 automorphisms, with uniqueness bounding the group by 20. Independently counted signed fixed independent faces for all 20 automorphisms; reduced H4 trace is 2 for even powers r^k and sr^k and zero for odd, giving Q[D10]-module 1⊕ε with ε(r)=-1, ε(s)=+1.
